question: After Jesus spoke, in what order did the accusers go away?
options: One at a time, the older ones first
The Pharisees first, then the teachers
explanation: John 8:9 says those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left with the woman. (The earliest manuscripts do not include John 7:53–8:11; the NIV prints it in brackets.)
